declared: 2026-10-13, before any result of run rev2_r1 existed
protocol: init seeds 96001-96299, deterministic policy, 60 s rollouts, commands 2 / 4 / 5.5 / 7 m/s; rev2_accept.py and disturb_tol.py

gates.fall: 0/299 falls at each of the four commands
gates.heat: mean (motor torque / continuous torque)^2 of every motor <= 1.0 at each command (299-run mean); margin target <= 0.8 reported separately
gates.clutch: knee clutch armed >= 95 % of stance time at each command; energy at engagement = 0; energy lost at release < 1 % of the motor positive work
gates.spring: at 4, 5.5 and 7 m/s: mean peak energy stored per stance >= 2 J, and removing the spring at evaluation raises the knee load^2 by >= 10 %
gates.geometry: every joint within 0.03 rad of a limit < 1 % of the time; self-contact step fraction = 0; knee inside the four-bar band
gates.disturbance_single: 0/16 falls at 2, 4 and 7 m/s for one impulse of: yaw 2.0, pitch 2.0, roll 2.0 N.m.s; lateral, forward, backward push 10 N.s
gates.disturbance_60s: 0/59 falls in 60 s at 2, 4 and 7 m/s with the training randomisation (yaw impulses 0.15/s up to 2.26 N.m.s, roll impulses 0.1/s up to 2.03 N.m.s, one push, mass/friction/torque draws)

baseline_rev2_td340.geometry: fail (knee near its lower band limit 6-8 % of the time)
